feature: Sidebar 4 tabs with all methodology information
scope: Add 4 organized tabs (Rendered / JSON / Markdown / Context) to the detail sidebar in docs/visualization/regulation_chain.html. Extend 5 Python loaders in build_regulation_chain.py to preserve raw JSON fields stripped by CORR-078 and embed source MD files from Methodology-main/00_METHODOLOGY/PREPROCESSING/. Add pure JS markdown renderer (mdToHtml) for the Markdown tab. Pre-compute cross-references at build time for the Context tab. HTML grows from 3.6 MB to ~6.6 MB. 4 sequential commits on branch feature/aegis-p1-corr-079-rich-sidebars. Build script is gitignored — modifications NOT committed, backup to /tmp/corr078_viz_backup/.

criteria.description: mdToHtml renders headings (H1-H6)
criteria.test_command:
cd /home/epmq-cyber/Área\ de\ Trabalho/projects/aegis-phase1 && PYTHONPATH=src ../shared-venv-root/bin/python -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
import re
with open('docs/visualization/build_regulation_chain.py') as f:
    src = f.read()
# Extract mdToHtml function (between def and next def at same indent)
m = re.search(r'def mdToHtml\(md[^)]*\)[^:]*:\s*\n(.+?)(?=\ndef |\nclass |\Z)', src, re.DOTALL)
if not m:
    # Try inline (arrow function or const)
    m = re.search(r'(?:function\s+)?mdToHtml\s*[=(][^=]*[=)]\s*[{](.+?)[}]\s*[;]?', src, re.DOTALL)
body = m.group(1) if m else ''
assert body, 'mdToHtml function not found'
assert 'h1' in body.lower() and 'h6' in body.lower(), 'mdToHtml does not handle H1-H6'
print('OK: mdToHtml handles headings (H1-H6)')
"
criteria.expected: OK: mdToHtml function defined and handles H1-H6 headings

risks: HTML size 3.6 → 6.6 MB may exceed browser memory limits — mitigated by lazy rendering (display:none until tab active) and gzip transfer
MD renderer edge cases (nested tables, escape chars) — mitigated by 9 fixture tests + <pre> fallback
Cross-ref pre-computation slow at build time — mitigated by O(n*m) with early termination; ~1-2s acceptable
Methodology-main symlink may not be present — mitigated by try/except + 'MD not available' fallback
build script is gitignored — mitigated by backup to /tmp/corr078_viz_backup/ after each commit
